text:
maria: Quick pass please — final draft of the product launch blog is up. It focuses on cost/latency benchmarks + webinar CTA. Link: https://drive.redwood/launch-blog-v5 (comments on doc). Need marketing sign-off, legal quickpass, and GTM routing for inbound leads. Target publish Fri 9am PT. @sam @alex

sam: reading now. quick note: can we tighten benchmark claims? prefer 'up to 3x cost savings' with source rather than vague language.

alex: pushed micro edits to paragraph 2 — moved the benchmark table up closer to the intro. looks tighter now. :thumbsup:

toni: legal quick pass — need source for the 'enterprise-grade SLA' line and backup for the numbers in the table. also please remove 'bank-grade' wording.

kevin: ops check — webinar capacity ok for 500 live attendees? current setup supports 400 seats + waitlist. recommend 45 min + 15 min Q&A. also confirm demo scheduling flow for post-webinar leads.

olga: hubspot routing note — will add hidden UTMs and map the interest checkbox to the 'webinar' contact list. i'll create workflow that tags leads and notifies sales.

maria: i've added source links for SLA and benchmark methodology in the doc under 'Benchmarks' and a 2-sentence methodology blurb. @toni pls recheck the legal language.

toni: can approve once links are present. one suggested edit: change 'guaranteed' -> 'target' when we talk SLA.

maria: done — switched to 'target SLA'.

alex: content approves from my side. tiny headline tweak suggestion: 'making inference predictable and economical' -> 'predictable, economical inference' (smoother).

sam: fine with publish timing if sales has lead routing in place. @olga will the HubSpot workflow tag these leads as 'early_access' for the webinar?

olga: yes. workflow: if form=webinar -> add tag 'webinar_early_access' + notify sales@redwood.com. preview + form snippet below.

olga: ```html
<input type='hidden' name='utm_campaign' value='redwood_dedicated_launch'/>
<input type='hidden' name='source' value='blog'/>
```

kevin: ops asks we add webhook to /hooks/demo-scheduler with payload (lead_email, interest:webinar) so SDRs auto-assign to queue 'Launch23'. will confirm SLA on demo response time later.

maria: legal-bot quick-scan: ran automated scan, flagged earlier phrases removed. @toni can you confirm final?

legal-bot: Automated scan complete. Flags resolved: 'bank-grade' removed, 'guaranteed' -> 'target' change detected. No remaining high-risk phrases.

toni: confirmed. legal OK.

alex: final checklist from content: publish blog, tweet + thread, embed webinar registration, attach benchmark assets. i'll grab hero image + charts after publish.

publish-bot: Scheduled publish set for 2026-03-27T16:00:00Z by maria. :rocket:

maria: thanks all — moving this to shiproom. small TODO: someone add webinar link to CTA in two places (hero + end).

sam: i'll create the webinar signup and add link to the doc. ETA ~2 hours.

olga: form + workflow created. preview: https://hubspot.preview/form/9876

maria: last call — anyone object to Friday 9am PT? react with :thumbsup: to approve.

kevin: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:

toni: :thumbsup:

olga: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

maria: great, thanks everyone — closing thread.
